text: {"quantities": [{"id": "q1", "value": 12, "unit": "miles", "kind": "distance", "span": "Marissa is hiking a 12-mile trail"}, {"id": "q2", "value": 4, "unit": "miles", "kind": "distance", "span": "1 hour to walk the first 4 miles"}, {"id": "q3", "value": 2, "unit": "miles", "kind": "distance", "span": "another hour to walk the next two miles"}, {"id": "q4", "value": 4, "unit": "miles per hour", "kind": "speed", "span": "she wants her average speed to be 4 miles per hour"}, {"id": "q5", "value": 1, "unit": "hour", "kind": "time", "span": "She took 1 hour to walk the first 4 miles"}, {"id": "q6", "value": 1, "unit": "hour", "kind": "time", "span": "another hour to walk the next two miles"}], "plan": [{"op": "div", "args": ["q1", "q4"], "out": "s1", "note": "total time the whole trail may take at the target average speed"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["q5", "q6"], "out": "s2", "note": "hours already spent walking"}, {"op": "sub", "args": ["s1", "s2"], "out": "s3", "note": "hours left for the rest"}, {"op": "sub", "args": ["q1", "q2"], "out": "s4", "note": "trail left after the first 4 miles"}, {"op": "sub", "args": ["s4", "q3"], "out": "s5", "note": "distance still to walk"}, {"op": "div", "args": ["s5", "s3"], "out": "s6", "note": "required speed for the remaining distance"}], "target": {"kind": "speed", "scope": "the speed in miles per hour she must walk the rest of the trail"}, "dismissed": []}
